reviewed_by: Codex; David approved the Figma layout; independent fresh-context root-cause validation before repair
reason: The paired terminal client gains a bounded reading layout, separated two-line conversation states, and an activity indicator that animates only during local reads or confirmed active turns. Forty-one focused Python cases cover presentation, real PTY geometry and spinner frames, retryable picker failure, stream/queue/wait/reconnect lifecycle, three authenticated TLS LAN Core journeys, and product-knowledge digest/sync. One frontend catalog test verifies discoverability of animation and reduced motion.
exclusions: The changed interface is the Python prompt_toolkit terminal, not a browser page; desktop/mobile Playwright and touch checks do not exercise this surface. Native runtime tests are unrelated. The selected Python LAN fixture uses synthetic paired projects and an inert provider; no operator data or live agent is touched. The full Python and frontend suites are excluded by the focused-test policy.
